snippet.title: Life on NEPTUNE Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
HELLO! The Life on NEPTUNE Demo is out on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115170/Life_on_NEPTUNE/

If you enjoy it, please wishlist it!
It's more of a preview than a demo- I feel like this is only a glimpse of the game it will eventually be when it comes out. The final version will just have More- more everything, ideally. I hope to see you there.

It's a exploring, home building, and socializing videogame. It's also my first big project in some time- I kept switching between projects before landing here post GREENER GRASS AWAITS, and it feels good to be working on something that will hopefully bear fruit. 

Life on NEPTUNE begins now 🔵

also here's the itchio link: https://yatoimtop.itch.io/life-on-neptune-demo
